infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ambassador Companion uses the camera to photograph contact cards and to record teleprompter practice.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ambassador Companion uses the microphone for voice-note captures and teleprompter practice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ambassador Companion uses the photo library only when you pick an existing photo of a contact card.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Ambassador Companion may save a teleprompter practice video when you tap Save.
